title: Bookmark toggle
body:
participant S as Screen participant T as ToggleBookmarkItem
(UBTConnect) participant B as MyBookmarks_BL participant G as LegacyShared S->>T: tap bookmark alt not bookmarked T->>B: AddBookmark T->>G: Create_LocalBookmark T->>G: AddBookmarkToCache T->>G: SendBookmarkedFeedbackMessage else bookmarked T->>G: Get_LocalBookmarkByObjectId T->>B: DeleteBookmarkByBookmarkId T->>G: RemoveBookmarkFromCache T->>G: Delete_LocalBookmarkByBookmarkId T->>G: SendBookmarkedFeedbackMessage end
caption: The server call goes to Connect2_MyBookmarks_BL. The device copy and the feedback message go to Connect2_LegacyShared (job: Local bookmarks). Screens: 11. Source: client_actions/ToggleBookmarkItem.cs.

title: Access gate → upgrade pop-up
body:
participant S as BrowseDirectory participant H as HasAccessToRegion
(UBTConnect) participant U as Utils S->>H: tap a region H->>U: Cache_UserInfo_Get U-->>H: cached user H-->>S: HasAccess alt no access S->>U: App_Subscription_ShowUpgradePopUp else access S->>S: open Locality_Details end
caption: Utils does two jobs here: Device cache (the user) and Subscription gate (the pop-up). The same gate guards 22 screens with their own call. Sources: screens/BrowseDirectory.cs, client_actions/HasAccessToRegion.cs.

title: Legacy wrapper screen
body:
participant S as LegacyShareObject participant U as Utils participant G as LegacyShared
ScreenBlock_ShareObject S->>U: Cache_UserInfo_Get (via GetUserInformation_Wrapper) U-->>S: User_AgeVisibility S->>G: render block (ObjectId, type, visibility) G-->>S: event SubscriptionDenied S->>U: App_Subscription_ShowUpgradePopUp
caption: A Legacy_* screen owns no business logic. It hosts one LegacyShared block (job: Legacy screen blocks) and answers its event with a Utils action. Same shape: ConnectShare, MessageList, MessageDetail, LDM_Email. Source: screens/LegacyShareObject.cs.

title: Notification badge
body:
participant N as App_NotificationIcon
(block on the layout) participant G as LegacyShared participant U as Utils N->>G: GetUnreadNotificationNumber G-->>N: unread count N->>U: GetHasNewNotifications alt flag on N->>N: open Notifications (new) else flag off N->>N: open MessageList (legacy) end
caption: The count comes from LegacyShared (job: Notification inbox). The Utils flag (job: Feature gate) picks the new or the legacy inbox. FCM_NotificationCallback refreshes the count after a push. Sources: blocks/App_NotificationIcon.cs, client_actions/FCM_NotificationCallback.cs.
